text:
sarah: Heads up — Alertmanager tripped on gpu_errant_card for gpunode-47, short ECC/Xid bursts on card=0. https://grafana.redwood.local/d/xyz
kevin: I see the spike, looks like a 2–3 minute burst then back to normal. no OOMs or driver crashes logged.
toni: are we sure this isn't DCGM transient noise? our rule is pretty sensitive rn. what's the current expr?
sarah: current alert uses `increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[1m]) > 0` with no `for`. pretty chatty. proposing to debounce.
kevin: agreed. proposal: move to a 5m window + require sustained bursts. also add per-card hysteresis so a one-off increment doesn't page.
sarah: rough rule idea (will refine in PR):
```yaml
- alert: GPU_ECC_Burst
  expr: increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total{device!=""}[5m]) > 1
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
    route: infra-low
  annotations:
    summary: "ECC bursts on {{ $labels.instance }} card {{ $labels.device }}"
```
toni: I like that. Another layer: create a recording rule that counts consecutive 5m windows to detect streaks instead of single-window checks. For example a recording rule `gpu:ecc_windows_5m:increase` then alert when `sum_over_time(gpu:ecc_windows_5m[30m]) >= 3`.
kevin: example PromQL for the recording rule: 
```promql
record: gpu:ecc_burst_5m
expr: increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m])
```
and alert: `sum_over_time(gpu:ecc_burst_5m[30m]) >= 3`
sarah: also change alertmanager routing: route these to infra-low / non-paged during rollout, and add inhibition for nodes with label `maintenance=true`. we should avoid paging on transient Xid spikes.
toni: can we tag cards that repeatedly hit this with `gpu_flaky=true` so scheduler avoids them and SRE can schedule reprovision?
kevin: yep — runbook: 1) check `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` 2) check `kubectl describe node` for GPU errors 3) if persistent, `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` + reprovision node or flag card via node labels. Add node to `gpu-flaky` rotation.
infra-bot: deploy: applied prometheus/recording-rule/pr-245 to staging cluster (prom-staging) — OK
sarah: awesome. kevin can you open the PR with the new rules and a short smoke test dashboard? we want 24h staging to ensure no regressions.
kevin: opening PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/312 :thumbsup:
toni: after we validate, default back to paged alerts only for severity=critical (device permanently failing). For warnings keep non-paged.
sarah: agreed. thanks all — we'll monitor for 48h and adjust thresholds.
